declarations.type:
SearchRouteInspectDriver.DecisionTotal →
  ∀ {initial : SearchRouteInspectLoop.InspectLoopState},
    SearchRouteInspectLoop.LoopWellFormed initial → Nonempty (SearchRouteInspectDriver.ClosedTraceReceipt initial)
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectDriver.decision_total_produces_closed_trace

declarations.type:
∀ {initial finalState : SearchRouteInspectLoop.InspectLoopState} {steps : Nat},
  SearchRouteInspectLoop.InspectLoopTrace initial finalState steps →
    SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse finalState.selected initial.selected
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectDriver.trace_selected_no_worse

declarations.type:
∀ {candidateUniverse : List SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate},
  SearchRouteInspectDriver.DecisionTotal →
    ∀ {initial : SearchRouteInspectLoop.InspectLoopState},
      SearchRouteInspectLoop.LoopWellFormed initial →
        SearchRouteInspectLoop.LoopCovers candidateUniverse initial →
          ∃ receipt,
            receipt.steps ≤ SearchRouteInspectLoop.loopWork initial ∧
              SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse receipt.finalState.selected initial.selected ∧
                ∀ (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
                  candidate ∈ candidateUniverse → SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse receipt.finalState.selected candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectDriver.decision_total_produces_bounded_global_optimum

declarations.type:
∀ {state : SearchRouteInspectLoop.InspectLoopState},
  ¬SearchRouteInspectLoop.LoopClosed state →
    Nonempty (SearchRouteInspectLoop.InspectLoopTrace state state 0) ∧ ¬SearchRouteInspectLoop.LoopClosed state
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectDriver.safety_trace_alone_allows_early_stop
